steps.title: Setup
steps.markdown:
# Setup

Install Node.js 22 and open the lab folder in VS Code.

Run `node --version` to check the install.

steps.title: While loops
For loops
Arrays
steps.markdown:
# Arrays

An array holds an ordered list of values. Use `push` to add to the end and `length` to count items.

steps.title: Iterating arrays
steps.markdown:
# Iterating

Use `for...of` to visit each element, or `forEach` with a callback.

steps.title: Modules
steps.markdown:
# ES Modules

Use `import` and `export` to share code between files in this lab.
